hook_line: GUKESH DEFENDS HIS WORLD CROWN AT 20

hook_stat.sub: Classical title match in Geneva from November 24 to December 12

diaspora_bullets: Youngest World Championship battle in chess history, with both players aged 20
Gukesh is only the second Indian to win the title after Viswanathan Anand
news_summary: World champion D Gukesh, 20, offered prayers at the Tirumala Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple in Andhra Pradesh on November 6 ahead of defending his title against Javokhir Sindarov in Geneva.
payoff: Gukesh defends his crown against Sindarov in Geneva from November 24 to December 12.
